name: Check archive integrity and indexing
title: Check archive integrity and indexing
description: Use this as a routine archive-control check. Investigate failed/missing checksum or index states, expired assets, and ingest failures. Do not delete or overwrite evidence to make a report clean; preserve audit trail and escalate according to policy.
report_description: Review checksum, retention, external-reference, ingest, and indexing health. Resolve missing or mismatched checksums, failed indexes, and invalid references according to approved retention and incident procedures.
